values: ⚠️ Important! This Catalog template has changed.

In order to improve the shopping experience for Customers, we are changing how we collect, categorize and display your listing data. This includes the types of data that are required, conditionally required, and optional.
What types of changes will I see?

1. The Price & Quantity template will be generated based on your account marketplace and your customer segments. You will see updated labels for your offer attributes. Amazon has updated the grouping of 'Offer' attributes to improve multi-offer listing capability for those catering to more than one customer segment (like Sell on Amazon, Amazon Business, Haul, etc).

If you are authorized to sell through Amazon Business, you will see offer attributes to set prices for that intended customer segment. You will see "Sell on Amazon" (to set standard customer prices) and "Amazon Business" (to set discounted business price) Offer attributes. In this new template, the business price is called as 'Your Price" under 'Offer - Amazon Business (B2B)'. Quantity Discount attributes are also now available within the Offer attributes group to simplify setting of quantity discounts for business offers.

If you are authorized to sell through Amazon Haul, you will see offer attributes to set prices for that intended customer segment. You will see "Sell on Amazon" (to set standard customer prices) and "Haul" (to set prices in low-cost store) Offer attributes.

2. The Offer attributes group include fulfillment availability attributes like Fulfillment Channel, Quantity, etc. SKU is the only required column of the template, with all other columns being optional or conditionally required. Fulfillment Channel will need to be provided to change Quantity, Handling Time, Restock Date, and Inventory Always Available attributes.

3. You can delete your existing offers using this template by providing a SKU and setting "Your Price" column of the particular customer segment of the offer to "Delete Offer" dropdown value instead of a numerical value.
How will this affect me right now?
You may continue to use the old templates until further notice. We will notify 30 days before the date from which you will no longer be able to upload the old templates to create or update listings.
How will I know that I am generating the new template?
Download a template using the Add Products page as usual. We will let you know that you are generating a new template through a message alert before you generate the template.
What can I do to prepare for the change?

Download the new templates. Review the changes to the attributes so you know what to expect. Provide all new required attributes for all your listings. We recommend making these changes sooner to take advantage of additional features such as improved dropdown and conditional requirement highlights.

values: This page contains information you need to create, validate and upload your Price & Quantity template to Amazon. This template can be used to update listings that are already in your catalog. If you wish to create a new listing, please find the appropriate Product or Offer template to create your new listing or offer.
The Data Definitions tab contains the acceptable values that can be used as you fill out the Template tab.
The Data Definitions tab also indicates whether a field is Required or Optional:

Required: Required fields are the minimum attribute values necessary to update your listing in the Amazon catalog. Required cells will be highlighted in RED in the template once you have added a SKU for that row. Failure to enter a valid value in a required field will prevent your listing from being updated in the catalog. Additional conditional attributes may be required depending on the values you enter elsewhere in this template. (For example, you must provide Quantity if you provide Fulfillment Channel as merchant fulfilled)

Optional: Optional fields give Amazon customers the product information that is useful, but not critical, when making purchasing decisions. We recommend that you provide as much Optional attribute data as possible for your listing. In some cases, fields we have labeled Optional may be important to your product or business, or required according to your merchant agreement.

As indicated in the Data Definitions tab, some fields require that you use terms from the Valid Values tab. These terms are specific to the attribute and are used for categorization and product discoverability like through search.
The Template tab is where you will enter the information to update your listings by providing a SKU and adding data to the attribute columns you want to update in that row.

The default template tab view will show the required, conditionally required, and recommended attributes. Conditionally required attributes become required based on your inputs to the required attributes. Optional attributes are collapsed in each attribute group, and you can expand the optional attributes by clicking the "+" or "-" signs on top of the column. Alternatively, on the top left corner of the sheet, you can select "1" or "2" to collapse or expand all the optional attributes. Option "1" shows the default view which collapses optional attributes and option "2" shows the advanced view which expands all the attributes. The default view will not hide at least the first attribute in each group. After adding SKU for a row in the template, the required fields in that row will be highlighted in RED. Attributes that are not applicable will be grayed out in that row. We recommend that you provide all the applicable attributes in the default view first, such as highlighted cells, to prevent missing required attribute errors. For the best results, also submit as much optional data as possible for your products. If you are not providing data for a particular non-required field, leave the cell blank. Feel free to add color, boldface, borders and other formatting (not additional text) to the template if it is helpful to you. Note that high ASCII characters (such as ®, ©) and HTML tags are not allowed.

The Offer attributes group include fulfillment availability attributes like Fulfillment Channel, Quantity, etc. SKU is the only required column of the template, with all other columns being optional or conditionally required. Fulfillment Channel will need to be provided to change Quantity, Handling Time, Restock Date, and Inventory Always Available attributes.

You can delete your existing offers using this template by providing a SKU and setting "Your Price" column of the particular customer segment of the offer to "Delete Offer" dropdown value instead of a numerical value.

Do not provide a value in the 'Quantity' column for items that are fulfilled by Amazon (FBA). The quantity column should be used only for merchant-fulfilled SKUs (MFN). The inventory quantity for Amazon-fulfilled SKU's will be determined by the number of items received at the Amazon fulfillment center. If you provide a value in the 'Quantity' column for SKUs that are fulfilled by Amazon, they will convert to merchant-fulfilled.
Columns: Do not duplicate or delete columns.
Find and replace: Avoid using this, as it can cause problems with content that is included in the template when you download it.
Renaming sheets or tabs: Do not do this, as we use the names to recognize different types of information.
Use Microsoft Excel: Other software may not support certain functionality.

Copy and paste: Copying and pasting into a column with a drop-down overwrites the drop-down configuration. If you paste a value which isn't in a drop-down, this may lead to issues when you upload your file.
Upload your file from the "Spreadsheet" section of the Add Products in Seller Central here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/product-search/bulk

When you upload your file, our system will automatically validate your data file as it is submitted. When your submission is complete, you will be able to download a processing report. Any errors in the upload will appear in a Processing Report. This report can be downloaded from the Check Upload Status page in your seller account on Seller Central here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/listing/status
Note: We recommend first uploading 15 or fewer products for testing purposes. You can upload the rest of your inventory once you have completed a successful test.

From time to time, Amazon will update valid values, data validation rules, explanatory text, and requirements. In the event that you submit an outdated template, we will convert your spreadsheet into the latest version, prefilled with your submission data. To prevent potential issues, you can download this latest version and address any highlighted errors before resubmitting your listings.
If you have read the Instructions or Data Definitions tabs of this file and still have questions, consult Seller Help, starting with this page: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G1641

values: How to complete your inventory template
This attribute indicates the SKU number as assigned by the contributor
For those merchants using Amazon fulfillment services, this designates which fulfillment network will be used. Specifying a value other than DEFAULT will cancel the Merchant-fulfilled offering.
Enter the quantity of the item you are making available for sale. This is your current inventory commitment (as a whole number)
Provide the time, in days, between when you receive an order for an item and when you can ship the item
Provide the date that product will be restocked using YYYY-MM-DD format

Always available inventory is an alternative to quantity that allows inventory to never deplete. Enabling or disabling will toggle this feature on or off. Note that a quantity cannot be specified when provided.
Your Price USD (Sell on Amazon, US)
Provide base price of the item at which it is being offered to the intended buyer segment (Sell on Amazon)
The pricing rule that will automate price on this offer (Sell on Amazon)
Minimum Seller Allowed Price (Sell on Amazon, US)
Provide the minimum seller allowed price (Sell on Amazon)
Maximum Seller Allowed Price (Sell on Amazon, US)
Provide the maximum seller allowed price (Sell on Amazon)
Sale Price USD (Sell on Amazon, US)
The price at which you offer the product for sale. (Sell on Amazon)
Sale Start Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
The date that the sale price will begin to override the product's standard price(YYYY-MM-DD format); the sale price will be displayed after 0:00AM of Sale From Date. (Sell on Amazon)
Sale End Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
The last date that the sale price will override the item's standard price (YYYY-MM-DD format); the product's standard price will be displayed after 0:00AM of Sale End Date. (Sell on Amazon)
Offering Release Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
Provide your price start date using YYYY-MM-DD format (Sell on Amazon)
Stop Selling Date (Sell on Amazon, US)
Provide your price end date using YYYY-MM-DD format (Sell on Amazon)
Provide base price of the item at which it is being offered to the intended buyer segment (Amazon Business (B2B))
Minimum Seller Allowed Price (Amazon Business (B2B), US)
Provide the minimum seller allowed price (Amazon Business (B2B))
Maximum Seller Allowed Price (Amazon Business (B2B), US)
Provide the maximum seller allowed price (Amazon Business (B2B))
Provide your price start date using YYYY-MM-DD format (Amazon Business (B2B))
Provide your price end date using YYYY-MM-DD format (Amazon Business (B2B))
Provide whether the quantity price type is fixed, a price set in local currency for each quantity threshold, or a percentage of product’s price (Amazon Business (B2B))
Quantity Threshold (Lower Bound, Amazon Business (B2B), US)
Provide the minimum purchase quantity necessary to receive the discount. It will apply to all units if the quantity threshold is met. (Amazon Business (B2B))
Quantity Price (Fixed Price/Percentage Discount, Amazon Business (B2B), US)
Provide the quantity price for each quantity threshold or the discount percentage offered on the business price for each quantity threshold. (Amazon Business (B2B))
